name: verify
description: check that two ink maps of the same input agree, with a control

inputs.name: reference
inputs.label: reference map, e.g. the CPU run (an ink detection label)

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.label: map to check, e.g. the MPS run (an ink detection label)

inputs.name: control
inputs.label: a map that must not agree, e.g. the reverse-depth output (an ink detection label)
